title: Structure-based virtual screening for identification of potential non-steroidal LXR modulators against neurodegenerative conditions.
authors: Deshwal, Sonam; Baidya, Anurag Tk; Kumar, Rajnish; Sandhir, Rajat
journal: The Journal of steroid biochemistry and molecular biology
one_liner_zh: 该研究针对核受体LXR进行虚拟筛选和分子动力学模拟，对象为蛋白质-小分子互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Liver X Receptors (LXRs) are members of the nuclear receptor superfamily that regulate cholesterol metabolism. LXRs have been suggested as promising targets against many neurodegenerative diseases (NDDs). The present study was aimed to identify novel non-steroidal molecules that may potentially modulate LXR activity. The structure-based virtual screening (SBVS) was used to search for suitable compounds from the Asinex library. The top hits were selected and filtered based on their binding affinity for LXR alpha and beta isoforms. Based on molecular docking and scoring results, 24 compounds were selected that had binding energy in the range of - 13.9 to - 12 for LXRalpha and - 12.5 to - 11 for LXRbeta, which were higher than the reference ligands (GW3965 and TO901317). Further, the five hits referred to as model 29, 64, 202, 250, 313 were selected by virtue of their binding interactions with amino acid residues at the active site of LXRs. The selected hits were then subjected to absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) analysis and blood-brain permeability prediction. It was observed that the selected hits had better pharmacokinetic properties with no toxicity and could cross blood-brain barrier. Further, the selected hits were analysed for dynamic evolution of the system with LXRs by molecular dynamics (MD) simulation at 100 ns using GROMACS. The MD simulation results validated that selected hits possess a remarkable amount of flexibility, stability, compactness, binding energy and exhibited limited conformational modification. The root mean square deviation (RMSD) values of the top-scoring hits complexed with LXRalpha and LXRbeta were 0.05-0.6 nm and 0.05-0.45 nm respectively, which is greater than the protein itself. Altogether the study identified potential non-steroidal LXR modulators that appear to be effective against various neurodegenerative conditions involving perturbed cholesterol and lipid homeostasis.
abstract_zh: 肝X受体（Liver X Receptors, LXRs）是核受体超家族成员，调节胆固醇代谢。LXRs已被认为是针对多种神经退行性疾病（neurodegenerative diseases, NDDs）的有前景靶点。本研究旨在识别可能调节LXR活性的新型非甾体分子。采用基于结构的虚拟筛选（structure-based virtual screening, SBVS）从Asinex库中搜索合适的化合物。根据其对LXRα和LXRβ亚型的结合亲和力，筛选并过滤了排名靠前的化合物。基于分子对接和评分结果，选择了24种化合物，其结合能范围对LXRα为-13.9至-12，对LXRβ为-12.5至-11，均高于参考配体（GW3965和TO901317）。进一步，根据与LXR活性位点氨基酸残基的结合相互作用，选择了五个命中化合物，分别称为模型29、64、202、250和313。随后，对选中的命中化合物进行了吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity, ADMET）分析以及血脑屏障通透性预测。观察到选中的命中化合物具有更好的药代动力学特性，无毒性，并能穿越血脑屏障。进一步，使用GROMACS在100 ns下进行分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，分析选中的命中化合物与LXRs系统的动态演化。MD模拟结果验证了选中的命中化合物具有显著的灵活性、稳定性、紧凑性和结合能，并表现出有限的构象变化。与LXRα和LXRβ复合的最高评分命中化合物的均方根偏差（root mean square deviation, RMSD）值分别为0.05-0.6 nm和0.05-0.45 nm，均大于蛋白质本身。总体而言，本研究识别了潜在的非甾体LXR调节剂，这些调节剂似乎对涉及胆固醇和脂质稳态紊乱的各种神经退行性疾病有效。
